Cadre 3.5.0 adds beta support for the native Zed Agent while keeping Codex and
Claude Code stable. Cadre lifecycle, governance, project-state, and active v2
template semantics are unchanged.

## Native Zed Agent beta

- Adds `cadre-ai install --target zed`, Zed auto-detection, and Zed selection
  through `--target all`.
- Generates all ten `/cadre-*` workflow adapters from the canonical Cadre
  skills and installs collision-safe links under `~/.agents/skills`.
- Preserves comments and unrelated values while configuring
  `~/.config/zed/settings.json` with the absolute packaged Cadre MCP runtime.
- Adds one exact `mcp:cadre:<tool>` allow rule for each of the 22 Cadre tools,
  unless installation uses `--prompt-mcp-tools`.
- Removes only Cadre-owned Zed links and a matching context server during
  uninstall, preserving permission preferences and unrelated settings.

## Runtime compatibility

- Adds optional `contentMode: "text"` output to `template_get_many` for Zed;
  existing clients retain embedded resources by default.
- Keeps the existing `workflow_elicit` chat fallback for clients without form
  elicitation support.
- Centralizes all 22 MCP tool names across registration, permissions,
  validation, and tests.
- Keeps template set v2 and all lifecycle/governance semantics unchanged.
  Existing 3.4 projects use the normal explicit `refresh` flow to record the
  3.5 runtime version before further mutation.

## Install or upgrade

```bash
npm install -g cadre-ai@3.5.0
cadre-ai doctor
cadre-ai install --target all --scope user
```

Start a new Codex conversation, run `/reload-plugins` in Claude Code, and open
a new native Zed Agent thread. Zed support is beta; confirm all ten
`cadre-*` skills and the Cadre MCP server, then run `/cadre-status`.

## Verification

- Frozen workspace install using pnpm 11.4.0.
- Harness typecheck, complete CLI/integration tests, package validation, and
  npm dry-run packing for `cadre-ai@3.5.0`.
- Documentation content, lint, typecheck, and static production build.
- Native installer validation for Codex, Claude Code, and the Zed Agent beta.
- Zed adapter, JSONC preservation, exact permission, idempotence, conflict,
  uninstall, text-template, and no-elicitation fallback coverage.

Read the [package changelog](https://github.com/vishal-kr-barnwal/cadre/blob/release-3.5.0/harness/CHANGELOG.md) or the [full 3.4.0...3.5.0 comparison](https://github.com/vishal-kr-barnwal/cadre/compare/release-3.4.0...release-3.5.0).
